results.name: Lowpoly People + Waldo
results.description:
![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/pt9vSUA.jpg)
*Sample render in blender cycles: 10k particles - 2880x750 - 256 samples - ~7min on i7, 16gb RAM and GTX1060*

 

A collection of 282 (A.K.A more than you'll ever need) lowpoly people. Allright. Who cares. **Where is waldo?!**, that's the real question!

Automagically remeshing body scans to lowpoly assets (check out my growing collection of [free assets](https://skfb.ly/6yQSW)!), which can be used for archviz placeholders.

Each model has its origin located at its feet, so that placement in a scene is made easy. However, some refined scaling is probably needed as some children have become giants in the process...

Original scans from @FrancescoPusterla @fablabbudapestitseez3d @jc @my3dworld @justin.levitz @peel-3d.com @deathlessvr @myminimate @3DCap @onepoint @fwild @marpi @conjurer @thor3D @vitronic @3dhubs @codame @benhaim - all licensed under CC-attribution.

results.name: WIP - Lowpoly People - 2
results.description:
Still working on automated body scans (this time from @itseez3d) reprocessing. ( [There are more!](https://skfb.ly/6zqCE) )

The noses are still bothering me, and I fear I'll have to include a manual step in my scripted workflow to keep more geometry on the face than on the body.

1500 triangles models, 1024px albedo and normal maps. The model materials are from front to back: 

1. albedo + normal map
2. normal map only
3. smoothed normals (no albedo, no normal map)
4. flat shaded

As usual, feel free to re-use for any purpose under the CC-attribution rules, and stay tuned to [my lowpoly assets collection]( https://skfb.ly/6yXXZ ), as more will come soon!

results.name: WIP - Lowpoly People - 1
results.description:
Trying out some remeshing scipts in blender/python on body scans! These ones come from the collection [Codame Labs] from @codame - all licensed under CC-attribution. As usual, feel free to re-use for nearly anything, and go check [my growing collection of free assets](https://skfb.ly/6yQSW) ;)

[There are more!](https://skfb.ly/6zqCE)

Each model is made of 1500 triangles, and has its origin located on the ground plane. Obviously, scans with multiple people have a lower precision.

I removed the textures to keep the faces as flat shaded, as this is the step I'm currently thinking about: geometry.
In particular, how to keep the characters nose - otherwise the face feels too flat - while remeshing in my (automated) workflow.

This could be done by specifying, with just one manual intervention (but not automated anymore!), the face as a zone of higher resolution and giving this input as a metric to [mmgs](http://mmgtools.org). Will think about it...

More to come soon as I make progress and if I feel inspired!

results.name: Plane Crash by a Brothel in Nevada
results.description:
Saw this on a highway driving through Nevada, so I HAD to capture it.

**Plane**
In what must have seemed like a good idea at the time, the owners of the brothel promoted an interesting challenge with a very naughty prize. A mattress would be placed in the center of a large star painted on the desert floor—if one were to parachute out of an airplane (airplane provided) and land on the mattress, they would be the lucky winner of a night with the lady of his choice, on the house!

Unsurprisingly, things went horribly wrong. Long story short, scantily-clad women plus distracted, inexperienced pilot plus heavy cross winds equal the plane plummeting straight into the ground. Luckily no one was hurt in the accident, and the clever owners decided that the wreck was enough of a spectacle to attract people from the road, so there it stayed - https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/angel-s-ladies-brothel

**Method**
322 images shot with a Mavic Pro 2. Reconstructed with Reality Capture

results.name: Mar Saba Monastery  -RAWscan
results.description:
The Holy Lavra of Saint Sabbas the Sanctified, known in Arabic as Mar Saba  is an Eastern Orthodox Christian monastery overlooking the Kidron Valley at a point halfway between the Old City of Jerusalem and the Dead Sea, within the Bethlehem Governorate of the West Bank.
The traditional date for the founding of the monastery by Sabbas the Sanctified of Mutalaska, Cappadocia is the year 483. Today, the complex houses around 20 monks. It is considered to be one of the oldest inhabited monasteries in the world, and still maintains many of its ancient traditions. One in particular is the restriction on women entering the main compound. The only building that women can enter is the Women's Tower, near the main entrance.

results.name: Wounded Amazon
results.description:
Wounded Amazon, Rome, 150 A.D., Marble

In Greek art, the Amazons, a mythical race of warrior women from Asia Minor, were often depicted battling such heroes as Herakles, Achilles, and Theseus. This statue represents a refugee from battle who has lost her weapons and bleeds from a wound under her right breast. Her chiton is unfastened at one shoulder and belted at the waist with a makeshift bit of bridle from her horse. Despite her plight, her face shows no sign of pain or fatigue. She leans lightly on a pillar at her left and rests her right arm gracefully on her head in a gesture often used to denote sleep or death. Such emotional restraint was characteristic of classical art of the second half of the fifth century B.C. 

![](http://rigsters.com/sketchfab_img/wounded-amazon-rigsters.jpg)
